result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: delivery banner, category chips, and restaurant cards are properly styled with good contrast and no overlapping or misaligned elements. Issues excluded per instructions (horizontally scrollable carousel items and viewport-cut content). One minor concern remains: the delivery time badges on carousel cards rely on dark blurred photo backgrounds, which could hurt legibility with real imagery.

issues.description: Delivery time badges (e.g. '15-25 min') sit directly on photo backgrounds with no scrim; with varied real-world imagery, text contrast may drop below accessible levels.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle gradient scrim or semi-transparent backing behind the time badge so it remains readable over any image.
